Chuck:  Your experiment is extremely interesting.  However, there are
still some serious problems with the monitor apropos extended
addressing: we have found several JSi that crash the system when
called from non-zero sections, or do wierd things (CFORK, CLOSF, etc).
I suspect, though I can't produce a lot of evidence, that a large
amount of work is in store if we wanted to make TOPS-20 REALLY support
extended addressing.  (Len, can you comment?)
